verdict.rationale: Expensify markets an AI feature that reads receipts (SmartScan) and can categorize, tag, and create expenses via plain language (expensify-docs-3, expensify-docs-6, expensify-docs-18), but there is no evidence of AI-driven duplicate or fraud detection. Community hands-on reports directly contradict the categorization-quality claim, stating Expensify 'does pretty horrible categorization' and gets it wrong ~70% of the time (expensify-comm-1, expensify-comm-4), and also raise concerns about human (mechanical turk) processing of receipt data rather than pure AI (expensify-comm-2, expensify-comm-3). Missing for 10: explicit fraud/duplicate detection capability, independent verification of the newer 'Expensify AI' feature's accuracy, and resolution of the categorization-accuracy complaints.
